description.value: Papa Greek is a fast-casual Greek restaurant that has been preparing traditional Greek food for over 25 years, sourcing fresh local ingredients including farm-fresh chicken from Abbotsford. The restaurant bridges the gap between fast food and sit-down dining, serving hearty platters with rice, potato, Greek salad, and tzatziki in under 10 minutes. Nearly the entire menu is gluten-free, making it a reliable stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 65m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 80m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Papa Greek is an active fast-casual Greek restaurant with locations in Burnaby and Abbotsford. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('your order is ready for pick-up'). Gluten-free options are confirmed ('Nearly everything on our menu is Gluten Free'). Vegetarian options confirmed by falafel and spanakopita platters. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM coordinates fall in the Burnaby/Vancouver area, matching the Burnaby address on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; address and phone populated from website's Burnaby location based on coordinate proximity.
Website mentions a Maple Ridge location phone number (604-466-4060) but only lists Burnaby and Abbotsford addresses — Maple Ridge location may have closed or been replaced.
OSM community is 'Vancouver' but the Burnaby address is technically in Burnaby, not Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate fast-casual Greek restaurant in Burnaby with dine-in, takeout, and strong gluten-free options. A touring cyclist would benefit from quick, hearty, affordable meals with dietary accommodations.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location business; this OSM node corresponds to the Burnaby location. An Abbotsford location also exists. Catering options available.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Nearly everything on the menu is gluten-free (only pita bread and spanakopita contain gluten). Vegetarian options include falafel platter, spanakopita platter, and Greek salad. Staff accommodate food allergies on request

wow_evidence: preparing traditional Greek food for over 25 years, locations in Burnaby and Abbotsford
